_comment: #199. warn: a StatefulSmartContract none of whose public methods is terminal (continuationShape isTerminal: no state write, no addOutput/addRawOutput, no addDataOutput) and none of which calls addOutput/addRawOutput, directly or through an inlined private helper, keeps its value forever: every spend takes the default single-output continuation, whose F-024 floor (_newAmount >= input amount) lets the value grow but never shrink. Every tier emits the shared NON-FATAL warning (stderr, exit 0, same bytes as without it); the nowarn shapes must not carry it. A contract with zero mutable fields has only terminal methods; an accepted @sighash SINGLE stateful method always declares its own output (sighash-validate refuses the others), so it never warns.
warning_template: contract '<contract>' has no terminal method and no public method that calls addOutput/addRawOutput; its satoshis can never leave instances of '<contract>'
